Contact
Diplomatic Office of the Embassy of Montenegro in Brussels, based in Luxembourg
Visa regime
Nationals of Luxembourg may enter, pass through the territory of and stay in Montenegro up to 90 days, with a valid travel document, without a visa.
Nationals of Luxembourg may enter, pass through the territory of and stay in Montenegro up to 30 days, without a visa, with a valid identity card issued by the competent authority of Luxembourg.
Diplomatic relations
The Grand Duchy of Luxembourg recognized Montenegro's independence on 14 June, 2006, and diplomatic relations were established on 21 September, 2006.
Until the appointment of the new ambassador, the Embassy of Montenegro in Brussels, acredited for Luxembourg, currently operates at the level of charge d'affaires.
Ambassador of the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg to Montenegro, on a non-resident basis (based at the Foreign Ministry of Luxembourg), is H.E. Marc Hübsch.
